about.title: About Bussola
about.projectText: Bussola is free, open-source software for tracking your own money, hosted by you.
about.libraries: Bussola is built on open-source libraries; their licenses are in the source code repository.
about.pricesOn: Prices of crypto, ETFs, ETCs and stocks come from these services. Those marked Active are in use on this installation.
about.pricesOff: This installation has no price service: prices are typed by hand. Bussola can fetch them from the services below when you enable the optional quotes service.
about.use.stocks: ETF, ETC and stock prices, by ISIN
about.use.openfigi: maps an ISIN to its ticker (used with Twelve Data)
about.aiOff: This installation does not read bank notifications automatically: drafts are not created from them.
about.aiLocal: Bank notifications are read by a language model on your own network; their text does not leave it.
about.aiCloud: Bank notifications are read by a language model outside your network: the text of each notification is sent to that service.
profile.pushHint: When a bank notification reaches your inbox, this device can tell you, from Bussola itself, with no other app. The message only says that something is waiting for you to confirm.
profile.pushOff: Notifications are off on this device.
profile.pushOn: Notifications are on for this device.
profile.pushUnsupported: This browser cannot show notifications from Bussola.
profile.pushInsecure: Notifications need Bussola to be opened over HTTPS, or as the installed app.
profile.pushIos: On iPhone and iPad, notifications work only once Bussola is added to the Home Screen (Share, then Add to Home Screen) and opened from there.
profile.pushBlocked: Notifications are blocked for this site in the browser's settings. Allow them there, then come back.
profile.pushDocs: How to install Bussola on your phone
